load_structure_pdb_cif: load a PDB or CIF protein structure file and filter to backbone atoms for specified chains
extract_coords_from_structure: extract N, CA, C backbone coordinates and amino acid sequence from a biotite AtomArray structure
score_sequence_inverse_folding: score a protein sequence against backbone coordinates using an inverse folding model to compute log-likelihood
get_encoder_output_coords: get encoder representations from backbone coordinates using an inverse folding model encoder
CoordBatchConverter_from_lists: convert lists of backbone coordinates, confidence scores, and sequences into batched tensors for model input
